name: Chan Santa Cruz
native: Noj Kaaj Santa Cruz Xbáalam Naj
alt: Maya state of Chan Santa Cruz

predecessors.name: Republic of Yucatán
predecessors.text: the south-east of the Yucatán peninsula held by the Maya after the Caste War of 1847

successors.name: Mexico
successors.text: the state's lands, 'occupied by the Mexican army in 1901'; ceded to Mexico on paper by the British in 1893

capitals.name: Chan Santa Cruz (Noj Kaaj Santa Cruz Xbáalam Naj; today Felipe Carrillo Puerto)

ledger.x: 1849: the Maya proclaim the State of the Cross at Xocén.
1850: the Maya capital Chan Santa Cruz is founded around the Talking Cross.
1860: the state reaches its greatest extent.
May 1901: Mexico occupies Chan Santa Cruz.

wars.name: Caste War of Yucatán
